name: Microsoft Ads
label: Microsoft Advertising API v13 REST — campaigns, reports, conversions
description: Official Microsoft Advertising REST v13 (Campaign Management + Reporting). Hosts campaign.api.bingads.microsoft.com and reporting.api.bingads.microsoft.com. Handler: OfficialApiNode via api_spec.json. SOAP is not used (full deprecation 2027-01-31). Auth: OAuth Bearer access_token. extraHeaders send DeveloperToken, CustomerId, CustomerAccountId from config developer_token / customer_id / account_id. Customer owns the ad account. Never log developer_token, Bearer, click ids, or conversion emails.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation Campaign Management / Reporting REST JSON fields (PascalCase provider keys). Do not put secrets here. INPUT operation overrides config. Required: campaign.get=AccountId+CampaignIds; campaign.list=AccountId; campaign.mutate=AccountId+Campaigns; adGroup.list=CampaignId; ad.list=AdGroupId+AdTypes; report.submit=ReportRequest; report.poll=ReportRequestId; conversion.upload=OfflineConversions; audience.mutate=Audiences.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: campaign.get | campaign.list | campaign.mutate | adGroup.list | ad.list | report.submit | report.poll | conversion.upload | audience.mutate.

schema.label: CampaignIds
schema.description: campaign.get: long campaign ids, max 100. QueryByIds body key.

schema.label: CampaignType
schema.description: Space-delimited flags e.g. Search Shopping. Default Search when omitted. campaign.get / campaign.list.

schema.label: ReturnAdditionalFields
schema.description: Optional additional field flags for campaign.get, campaign.list, adGroup.list, ad.list.

schema.label: Campaigns
schema.description: campaign.mutate (POST /Campaigns = AddCampaigns): Campaign objects (Name, BudgetType, DailyBudget, CampaignType, …). Max 100.

schema.label: CampaignId
schema.description: adGroup.list: parent campaign id. QueryByCampaignId body key. Required for adGroup.list.

schema.label: AdGroupId
schema.description: ad.list: parent ad group id. QueryByAdGroupId body key. Required for ad.list.

schema.label: AdTypes
schema.description: ad.list: ad type enums e.g. ResponsiveSearch. Required for ad.list.

schema.label: ReportRequest
schema.description: report.submit: derived report request (Type e.g. CampaignPerformanceReportRequest, Aggregation, Columns, Time, Scope). Required for report.submit. One submit per node run.

schema.label: ReportRequestId
schema.description: report.poll: id from report.submit. Valid ≤ 1 day. One poll per node run. Do not download the report file here.

schema.label: OfflineConversions
schema.description: conversion.upload: ConversionName, ConversionTime UTC, MicrosoftClickId or hashed email. Max 1000. Never log.

schema.label: Audiences
schema.description: audience.mutate (POST /Audiences = AddAudiences): RemarketingList JSON. Max 100. CustomAudience / InMarketAudience / SimilarRemarketingList cannot be added.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. Size-capped. Never log secrets or raw PII.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: campaign.get | campaign.list | campaign.mutate | adGroup.list | ad.list | report.submit | report.poll | conversion.upload | audience.mutate.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Entra (or documented IdP) OAuth access token (StudioQuack secret). Authorization: Bearer. Refresh outside the hot path. Never on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Developer token
configurationParameters.description: Production developer token from ads.microsoft.com DevSettings (StudioQuack secret). Sent as header DeveloperToken on every call. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Client ID
configurationParameters.description: Entra app (or documented OAuth client) id. Not a secret. Token refresh only; not sent on Advertising REST calls.

configurationParameters.label: Client secret
configurationParameters.description: OAuth client secret (StudioQuack secret). Token refresh only; not sent on Advertising REST calls. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Tenant
configurationParameters.description: Entra tenant for work accounts. Default common. Token refresh only; not sent on Advertising REST calls.

configurationParameters.label: Customer id
configurationParameters.description: Manager account. Sent as header CustomerId on every call. Put AccountId on INPUT for QueryByAccountId / AddCampaigns bodies.

configurationParameters.label: Account id
configurationParameters.description: Ad account. Sent as header CustomerAccountId on every call. Also send INPUT AccountId when the REST body requires it.

configurationParameters.label: Environment
configurationParameters.description: prod uses campaign.api.bingads.microsoft.com and reporting.api.bingads.microsoft.com. Sandbox hosts are not rewritten from this flag — spec paths are production.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 45. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
